title: A Kernel-Aware Two-Grid Preconditioner for Cell-Centered Nearly Incompressible Elasticity
summary: Nearly incompressible elasticity is often discretized by mixed methods to avoid locking, but the resulting saddle-point systems can be expensive to solve. We consider a weakly symmetric multipoint stress discretization whose stress and rotation unknowns can be eliminated independently over vertex interaction regions, leaving a symmetric positive definite system for cell-centered displacement only.
